object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Through the MCP server, compare a document between Issue 1 and the latest commit, and between the latest commit and a working copy with an uncommitted edit and a new object. Expected: the same objects, with the same changes in the same order, as the Compare dialog finds; the edited object is Modified, with its description at both versions; the new object is Added, with its fields. Each change carries each changed field at From and at To.
